about: Performance Gate timing thresholds (scripts/perf-gate/ab-verdict.ts), set from six base-vs-base runs of 10 pairs on GitHub's ubuntu-24.04 runners, November 2026 (.agents/memory/performance.md). The worst base-vs-base paired median was 2.6% (43 ms) for a timing, 0.6% (3.7 MiB) for memory, 2 IPC calls and 0 processes. A head is slower or heavier when the median of its paired differences from the base exceeds the larger of the relative and the absolute limit. The gate reads main's copy; a pull request that loosens one is named in the report.
